slots.nav: inline-flex items-center justify-center h-8.5 min-w-8.5 bg-transparent border-[length:var(--bw-control)] border-base-300 rounded-control text-base-content/82 cursor-pointer text-[length:var(--icon-md)] shadow-control-rest
slots.today: inline-flex items-center justify-center h-8.5 px-3 bg-transparent border-[length:var(--bw-control)] border-base-300 rounded-control text-base-content/82 cursor-pointer font-body text-ctl-md font-semibold shadow-control-rest
slots.heading: m-0 ml-1 text-md font-semibold text-base-content
slots.weekday: font-mono text-ctl-2xs tracking-column-header uppercase font-bold text-base-content/62
slots.hourLabel: absolute right-2 -mt-1 font-mono text-ctl-2xs tracking-uppercase-status uppercase font-bold text-base-content/62
slots.rule: absolute left-0 right-0 border-t-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-base-300 pointer-events-none
slots.now: absolute left-0 right-0 border-t-[length:var(--bw-strong)] border-primary pointer-events-none
slots.chip: absolute box-border flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-left font-body mx-0.5 px-1.5 py-1 min-h-6.5 rounded-control border-l-[length:var(--bw-strong)] border-t-0 border-r-0 border-b-0
slots.chipBody: flex flex-col bg-transparent border-none p-0 m-0 text-left font-body
slots.title: text-ctl-sm font-semibold text-base-content whitespace-nowrap overflow-hidden text-ellipsis
slots.panel: absolute top-full right-0 flex gap-2 p-2 bg-surface-floating border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-base-300 rounded-control shadow-surface-floating
